verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement FR-CM-08 is not supported by the model as there is no class named 'Contact' that includes all the attributes mentioned in the requirement.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a 'Contact' class with the attributes: firstName, lastName, primaryPhoneNumber, secondaryPhoneNumber, email, jobTitle, and notes.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement FR-DA-01 and FR-DA-02 are not supported by the model as there is no class that tracks the addition and modification of records.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a 'Record' class with attributes for employee and date of addition/last modification.
